description: This file defines the ConfiguratorController class for the SuiteCRM platform, handling administrative actions such as font management, configuration saving, and history email/contact tracking.

classes.name: ConfiguratorController
classes.description: Controller class handling configuration-related administrative actions

methods.name: action_FontManager
methods.description: Sets view to 'fontmanager' for font management

methods.name: action_deleteFont
methods.description: Deletes a specified font and redirects back to the font manager view

methods.name: action_listview
methods.description: Sets view to 'edit' for listing configurations

methods.name: action_addFontView
methods.description: Displays the interface for adding a new font

methods.name: action_addFont
methods.description: Handles the upload and validation of new font files, then shows the result view

methods.name: action_saveadminwizard
methods.description: Saves admin wizard settings, configures scenarios and modules, then redirects

methods.name: action_saveconfig
methods.description: Saves configuration changes and clears caches

methods.name: action_detail
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' for displaying details

methods.name: action_historyContactsEmails
methods.description: Sets the view to 'historyContactsEmails' for managing email/contact history

methods.name: action_historyContactsEmailsSave
methods.description: Processes and saves visibility settings for email/contact history within modules
